Congressional Research Service (CRS) Products

The Congressional Research Service (CRS) is the public policy research arm of the United States Congress. CRS publishes several product types for congressional use.

CRS Product Types (3)

CRS Product Types are distinguished by length, purpose, and audience.

Report
A CRS Report provides in-depth research and analysis of a policy issue.
In Focus
A CRS In Focus product is a short, two-page overview of a single topic.
Legal Sidebar
A CRS Legal Sidebar is a short analysis of a discrete legal issue.

CRS Product Topics

Each CRS product edition is tagged with one or more topics that describe its subject matter. Topics are assigned to a specific product edition and are not published as a separate, versioned thesaurus independent of the product.
